symptom: `database from $currentObject/M.A1/M.A2` (a List View or pluggable database source over two associations) is refused with `entity "M.A2" in datasource … does not exist`, while the association source `$currentObject/M.A1/M.A2` builds; `database from $ctx/M.A1/M.E` with E an existing entity off A1 is written as stated
cause: buildDatabaseOverAssociationV3 (ako/mxcli#721 L5) walked the path two segments at a time — association, destination — and only checked the destination exists. resolveAssociationSourceHops had been taught every multi-hop spelling and the end-of-association check (mendixlabs/mxcli#1467), but it was not shared, so the second builder kept the old reading
insight: When an issue names a defect in "the builder", grep for every function that splits the same path: the one the triage comment cited had been fixed by another issue, and its twin, written later for a different datasource kind, still had the bug. Make both read the path through one function rather than porting the fix, so the two cannot drift again
